basis: Root supplied the implementation contract after gold was sealed, before any new implementation/model results were observed. Original semantic expectations remain frozen.

mapping.unsupportedForControlConflict: For RU09 and EN10, keep exact extract and map gold v1 reason not-supported to public-contract reason use-controls.
mapping.needsClarification: true exactly when expected.controlConflicts is nonempty; false for all other v1 cases.
mapping.setComparison: desiredCategories and excludedCategories ignore order and duplicates; all actual outputs still retained verbatim.
mapping.unsupportedComparison: Literal query extract, case-insensitive. Exact fragment preferred; benchmark reports per-attribute semantic coverage separately from strict exact-text equality to avoid conflating wording with missing attributes.
